description: This set of charts illustrates the distribution of categories—labeled N+K+, N-K+, N-K-, and N+K—across three difficulty levels: easy, medium, and hard. Each chart contains four slices. In the “easy” chart, the slices represent 55.4% for teal N+K+, 38.3% for orange N-K+, 4.7% for light orange N-K-, and 1.6% for red N+K. The “medium” chart shows 58.8% for teal N+K+, 35.4% for orange N-K+, 4.8% for light orange N-K-, and 1% for red N+K. Finally, the “hard” chart displays 37.3% for teal N+K+, 18.1% for orange N-K+, 37.9% for light orange N-K-, and 6.7% for red N+K. A legend is provided to the right of the charts, associating colors with each category label, and each slice is labeled with its corresponding percentage. The slices within each chart appear to be ordered clockwise, starting with the largest proportion.
